name: Lommatzsch (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Lommatzsch (a red crenellated wall with a building on white).
history: The flag is red and white striped horizontally with the arms laid on at the centre; the arms show in silver a red crenellated wall with black joints from which a red building rises.

features.role: Lommatzsch arms — wall with building on white
